[package]
name = "asio-sys"
version = "0.3.0"
authors = ["Tom Gowan <tomrgowan@gmail.com>"]
description = "Low-level interface and binding generation for the steinberg ASIO SDK."
repository = "https://github.com/RustAudio/cpal/"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/asio-sys"
license = "Apache-2.0"
keywords = ["audio", "sound", "asio", "steinberg"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.82"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
default-target = "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"
targets = []

[build-dependencies]
bindgen = "0.72"
walkdir = "2"
cc = "1.2"

[dependencies]
num-derive = "0.4"
num-traits = "0.2"

[package]
name = "cpal"
version = "0.18.1"
description = "Low-level cross-platform audio I/O library."
repository = "https://github.com/RustAudio/cpal"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/cpal"
license = "Apache-2.0"
keywords = ["audio", "sound"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.85"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["asio", "audioworklet", "custom", "jack", "pulseaudio", "realtime", "realtime-dbus", "wasm-bindgen"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]
targets = ["x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "aarch64-apple-darwin", "aarch64-apple-ios", "wasm32-unknown-unknown", "aarch64-linux-android", "x86_64-unknown-freebsd", "x86_64-unknown-netbsd", "x86_64-unknown-dragonfly"]

[badges.maintenance]
status = "actively-developed"

[features]
default = []
realtime = ["dep:audio_thread_priority", "dep:alsa-sys"]
realtime-dbus = ["realtime", "audio_thread_priority/with_dbus"]
asio = ["dep:asio-sys", "dep:num-traits"]
audioworklet = ["wasm-bindgen", "web-sys/Blob", "web-sys/BlobPropertyBag", "web-sys/Url", "web-sys/AudioWorklet", "web-sys/AudioWorkletNode", "web-sys/AudioWorkletNodeOptions"]
custom = []
jack = ["dep:jack"]
pipewire = ["dep:pipewire"]
pulseaudio = ["dep:pulseaudio", "dep:futures"]
wasm-bindgen = ["dep:wasm-bindgen", "dep:wasm-bindgen-futures"]

[dependencies]
dasp_sample = "0.11"

[dev-dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0"
hound = "3.5"
ringbuf = "0.4"

[dev-dependencies.clap]
version = ">=4.6, <5"
features = ["derive"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows-core]
version = ">=0.61, <=0.62"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows]
version = ">=0.61, <=0.62"
features = ["Win32_Media", "Win32_Media_Audio", "Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Devices_Properties", "Win32_Media_KernelStreaming", "Win32_System_Com_StructuredStorage", "Win32_System_Threading", "Win32_System_Performance", "Win32_Security", "Win32_System_SystemServices", "Win32_System_Variant", "Win32_Media_Multimedia", "Win32_UI_Shell_PropertiesSystem"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.audio_thread_priority]
version = "0.35"
optional = true
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.asio-sys]
version = "0.3.0"
path = "asio-sys"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.num-traits]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.jack]
version = "0.13.5"
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies]
alsa = "0.11"
libc = "0.2"

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.alsa-sys]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.audio_thread_priority]
version = "0.35"
optional = true
default-features = false

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.jack]
version = "0.13.5"
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.pulseaudio]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.futures]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.pipewire]
version = "0.10"
optional = true
features = ["v0_3_53"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies]
mach2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.coreaudio-rs]
version = "0.14.2"
default-features = false
features = ["core_audio", "audio_toolbox"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-core-audio]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "AudioHardware", "AudioHardwareDeprecated", "objc2", "objc2-foundation"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-audio-toolbox]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "AUComponent", "AudioUnitProperties"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-core-audio-types]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "CoreAudioBaseTypes"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-core-foundation]
version = "0.3"

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSArray", "NSString", "NSValue"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2]
version = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.jack]
version = "0.13.5"
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"ios\", target_os = \"tvos\"))".dependencies]
block2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"ios\", target_os = \"tvos\"))".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3"
features = ["block2", "NSDictionary", "NSNotification", "NSOperation"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"ios\", target_os = \"tvos\"))".dependencies.objc2-avf-audio]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "AVAudioSession", "AVAudioSessionTypes"]

[target."cfg(all(target_arch = \"wasm32\", target_os = \"unknown\"))".dependencies.wasm-bindgen]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(target_arch = \"wasm32\", target_os = \"unknown\"))".dependencies.wasm-bindgen-futures]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(target_arch = \"wasm32\", target_os = \"unknown\"))".dependencies.js-sys]
version = "0.3"

[target."cfg(all(target_arch = \"wasm32\", target_os = \"unknown\"))".dependencies.web-sys]
version = "0.3"
features = ["AudioContext", "AudioContextOptions", "AudioBuffer", "AudioBufferSourceNode", "AudioNode", "AudioDestinationNode", "Window", "AudioContextState"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
ndk-context = "0.1"
jni = "0.22"
libc = "0.2"
num-derive = "0.4"
num-traits = "0.2"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.audio_thread_priority]
version = "0.35"
optional = true
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.ndk]
version = "0.9"
default-features = false
features = ["audio", "api-level-26"]

[[example]]
name = "beep"

[[example]]
name = "enumerate"

[[example]]
name = "feedback"

[[example]]
name = "record_wav"

[[example]]
name = "synth_tones"

[package]
name = "symphonia"
description = "Pure Rust media container and audio decoding library."
authors = ["Philip Deljanov <philip.deljanov@gmail.com>"]
readme = "README.md"
categories = ["multimedia", "multimedia::audio", "multimedia::encoding", "multimedia::video"]
keywords = ["audio", "codec", "decoder", "multimedia", "media"]
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia"
license = "MPL-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia"
rust-version = "1.85"
version = "0.6.0"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[features]
default = ["opt-simd", "all-meta", "adpcm", "flac", "mkv", "ogg", "pcm", "vorbis", "wav"]
aac = ["dep:symphonia-codec-aac"]
adpcm = ["dep:symphonia-codec-adpcm"]
alac = ["dep:symphonia-codec-alac"]
flac = ["dep:symphonia-bundle-flac"]
caf = ["dep:symphonia-format-caf"]
isomp4 = ["dep:symphonia-format-isomp4"]
mkv = ["dep:symphonia-format-mkv"]
mp1 = ["dep:symphonia-bundle-mp3", "symphonia-bundle-mp3/mp1"]
mp2 = ["dep:symphonia-bundle-mp3", "symphonia-bundle-mp3/mp2"]
mp3 = ["dep:symphonia-bundle-mp3", "symphonia-bundle-mp3/mp3"]
ogg = ["dep:symphonia-format-ogg"]
pcm = ["dep:symphonia-codec-pcm"]
aiff = ["dep:symphonia-format-riff", "symphonia-format-riff/aiff"]
vorbis = ["dep:symphonia-codec-vorbis"]
wav = ["dep:symphonia-format-riff", "symphonia-format-riff/wav"]
ape = ["symphonia-metadata/ape"]
id3v1 = ["symphonia-metadata/id3v1"]
id3v2 = ["symphonia-metadata/id3v2"]
mpa = ["mp1", "mp2", "mp3"]
all-codecs = ["aac", "adpcm", "alac", "flac", "mp1", "mp2", "mp3", "pcm", "vorbis"]
all-formats = ["caf", "isomp4", "mkv", "ogg", "aiff", "wav"]
all-meta = ["ape", "id3v1", "id3v2"]
all = ["all-codecs", "all-formats", "all-meta"]
opt-simd-sse = ["symphonia-core/opt-simd-sse"]
opt-simd-avx = ["symphonia-core/opt-simd-avx"]
opt-simd-neon = ["symphonia-core/opt-simd-neon"]
opt-simd = ["opt-simd-sse", "opt-simd-avx", "opt-simd-neon"]
exp-subtitle-codecs = ["symphonia-core/exp-subtitle-codecs"]
exp-video-codecs = ["symphonia-core/exp-video-codecs"]

[dependencies]
lazy_static = "1.4.0"

[dependencies.symphonia-core]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-core"

[dependencies.symphonia-metadata]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-metadata"
default-features = false

[dependencies.symphonia-bundle-flac]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-bundle-flac"
optional = true

[dependencies.symphonia-bundle-mp3]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-bundle-mp3"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.symphonia-codec-aac]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-codec-aac"
optional = true

[dependencies.symphonia-codec-adpcm]

[dependencies.symphonia-format-riff]

[dependencies.symphonia-format-ogg]

log = "0.4"

[dependencies.symphonia-core]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-core"

[dependencies.symphonia-common]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-common"

[dependencies.symphonia-metadata]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-metadata"
default-features = false
features = ["vorbis"]

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)"]

[package]
name = "symphonia-format-riff"
description = "Pure Rust RIFF demuxer (a part of project Symphonia)."
authors = ["Philip Deljanov <philip.deljanov@gmail.com>", "dedobbin <dedobbindedobbin@gmail.com>"]
readme = "README.md"
categories = ["multimedia", "multimedia::audio", "multimedia::encoding"]
keywords = ["audio", "media", "demuxer", "aiff", "wav"]
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia"
license = "MPL-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia"
rust-version = "1.85"
version = "0.6.0"

[features]
default = ["aiff", "wav"]
aiff = ["symphonia-metadata/riff-id3"]
wav = ["symphonia-metadata/riff-info"]

[dependencies]
extended = "0.1.0"
log = "0.4"

[dependencies.symphonia-core]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-core"

[dependencies.symphonia-metadata]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-metadata"
default-features = false
features = []

[package]
name = "symphonia-metadata"
description = "Project Symphonia multimedia tag and metadata readers."
authors = ["Philip Deljanov <philip.deljanov@gmail.com>"]
readme = "README.md"
categories = ["multimedia", "multimedia::audio", "multimedia::encoding"]
keywords = ["multimedia", "media", "metadata", "id3v1", "id3v2"]
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia"
license = "MPL-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia"
rust-version = "1.85"
version = "0.6.0"

[features]
default = ["ape", "id3v1", "id3v2"]
ape = []
id3v1 = []
id3v2 = []
flac = ["vorbis"]
riff-info = []
riff-id3 = ["id3v2"]
vorbis = ["flac"]
riff = ["riff-id3", "riff-info"]

[dependencies]
lazy_static = "1.4.0"
log = "0.4"
regex-lite = "0.1.6"
smallvec = "1.13.1"

[dependencies.symphonia-core]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "../symphonia-core"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/ljufa/cpal"]
git = "https://github.com/ljufa/cpal"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "v_0.18.1_patched"

[source."https://github.com/ljufa/symphonia"]
git = "https://github.com/ljufa/symphonia"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "break_infinite_loop"
